name: MiDAS Foods International - USA
old_description: Midas Food International’s award-winning dry blends and food development expertise have revolutionized commercial kitchens for over 40 years. Discover why we’re a trusted partner of food manufacturers and restaurant chains nationwide.
about:
MiDAS Foods International operates from its main campus in Oak Park, Michigan, with a second facility in Birmingham, Alabama. The company has been developing dry blends and food solutions for over 40 years. Partners Richard Elias and Gary Freeman lead the business alongside a team of culinary and R&D executives.

The company engineers shelf-stable dry blends — including sauces, gravies, glazes, seasonings, soup mixes, cheese sauces, batter mixes, and dessert bases — that replicate or exceed scratch-made quality. Its combined U.S. R&D and manufacturing footprint exceeds 150,000 square feet, and an affiliate plant in Kashipur, India (Dry Blend Foods) serves more than 20 countries. The culinary team handles custom formulation, clean-label and plant-based ingredient systems, and manufacturing optimization.

MiDAS serves food processors, manufacturers, and casual-dining restaurant chains across the United States. Customers use its blends to replace ready-to-use sauces that are costly to ship and store, reducing SKU count, batching errors, and waste. Regional product lines cover North/Midwest and South/Southeast flavor profiles, from Michigan baked bean seasoning to Nashville hot sauce and Cajun étouffée mixes.

The company emphasizes sustainability: dry blends cut shipping weight, eliminate refrigeration, and lower energy use by three to six times compared with prepared sauces. MiDAS was built to give manufacturers and restaurants a single-source ingredient that delivers consistent flavor, faster prep, and lower total cost.
